name: Martim Galésio
bio: As Director, I am entrusted with guiding the Institute towards its mission while safeguarding its interests, values, and ethical integrity. I believe that a better tomorrow is not something we simply wait for. It is something we build together. Meaningful change begins with cooperation, but above all, it begins with the willingness to take initiative.

name: Giovanni De Brito
bio: As Head of Operations at the Helix Anthropis Institute, I am driven by the ambition to turn ideas into meaningful action. I’m excited to help build a stronger future, create real change, and work with others to make a lasting difference.

name: Mathieu Plaquevent
bio: My Mission: Coordinate, Manage, Lead. I am responsible for the coordination and preservation of the identity of Helix Anthropis Institute.
